summary: Quiet residential bend, homes 12-20 m from the kerb on this side.
reasons: Dwellings 12-20 m away on own side

best_section.where: North-east kerb on the bend, beside the large grey-roofed house's side garden

drivers.seclusion: Mapped homes at 9 m (at 9 m), 12 m (at 16 m) and 20 m (at 31 m); the 22-34 m part has the most clearance, with a garden hedge between kerb and house.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a verge beside the kerb; room to pull in looks fine.
drivers.convention: One car parked on the bend; no campers or regular parking seen.

flags: Witton Creek mapped about 9 m away, min elevation 34 m
sun_shade: Mostly open; hedge and trees on the garden side give some shade from the west.
